messages:
Priya: thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands. quick follow-up thread to capture concrete asks from the customer wins/losses discussion — please drop short notes or action items here.
AllHandsBot: recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.app/recording/2140009999 and https://redwood.app/slides/2140009999 :white_check_mark:
Evan: high-level signal from leadership: customers keep surfacing predictable latency at scale and clearer data residency. want compact asks we can act on this quarter.
Marco: from sales: we lost 2 mid-market deals to VendorX. primary reason was VendorX's explicit managed data residency SLA + a one-page compliance summary. ask: can product/ops produce a "private deployment checklist" for sales to include in RFPs?
Lena: on the wins side — retail POC succeeded because we demoed burst capacity under synthetic load and shared real perf maps. customers liked concrete numbers, not vague "low latency" claims. ask: can we surface per-model/per-route perf profiles as a shareable asset?
Celeste: eng-ml note: we can export 95p latencies, tokens/sec, and cost-estimates for key models. need product to define the canonical set of metrics.
Priya: action: product drafts two assets — (1) Private deployment checklist for RFPs, (2) Perf-profile one-pager — target: next Tue. volunteers to help?
Ryan: SalesOps will gather common RFP language and templates we see. I can centralize examples.
Marco: I added the two lost RFP snippets and redlines to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/sales/rfps/lost-q4 — will add notes on objection language.
Khalid: CS signal: biggest customer worry during migrations is cache warmup and parity between hosted and dedicated variants. they want a migration playbook they can follow with minimal downtime.
Chris: eng-platform: we already have an internal migration runbook and tooling for cache pre-warm. we can sanitize it and create a customer-facing migration checklist; will need CS to vet which bits are okay to publish.
Priya: @Chris will coordinate with @Khalid to sanitize and make customer-ready. product will publish to the COE hub and give Sales access.
Evan: leadership wants a prioritized list of top asks (max 3) from each org — product/eng/sales/CS. short bullets please.
Lena: Product/Eng asks: 1) expose per-route perf & cost in the console, 2) API to snapshot/restore KV cache during deploys.
Marco: Sales asks: 1) customer-ready private deployment checklist + legal boilerplate, 2) <72h RFP response SLA + pre-crafted answers.
Khalid: CS asks: 1) migration playbook + runbook customers can follow, 2) a clear rollback SLA and expectations doc for migrations.
Priya: I'll synthesize into a prioritization doc and propose owners tomorrow morning. thanks for the quick replies — please add any other signal or short attachments here. :pray:
